UP.translation: Maria onee‐chan lifted both hands up to the level of her head, and quietly unified her mind. ......The state that I could not attain without meditating for a long period of time, she reached in the span of a few quick breaths.

findings.sourceReading: 長い時間を掛けて瞑想しなくては至れない境地 means a state she cannot reach without spending a long time meditating. Maria reaches it with just a few low breaths. The comparison concerns required effort, not Ange failing after that effort.
findings.alternative: Ange struggled earlier, and either version emphasizes Maria’s superior ease. Nonetheless, the source has just depicted Ange attaining the first-step sensation; not been able to reach after replaces a necessary-condition statement with an asserted failure. Quick breaths also substitutes speed for the source’s low breathing.

MG.japanese: 「私の駒となり、このゲームが“絶対”に終わらないように私に協力する限り。私はあんたに、この世界が“絶対”に続くことを我が名において“絶対”に約束する！」
MG.translation: As long as you become my piece and help me so that this world "certainly" never ends... Then with "certainty", I'll swear upon my name that this world will "certainly" continue!"

UP.japanese: 「私の駒となり、このゲームが“絶対”に終わらないように私に協力する限り。私はあんたに、この世界が“絶対”に続くことを我が名において“絶対”に約束する！」
UP.translation: "As long as you become my piece, and help me so that this game is certain never to end, I'll grant you a certain promise, upon my name, that this world will certainly continue!"

findings.sourceReading: The condition concerns keeping the game going; the following promise concerns the world continuing.
findings.alternative: The game sustains the world within her account, but merging the two removes the stated condition and consequence distinction.

UP.translation: Right now, I was learning mental concentration from Maria onee‐chan in order to use magic. But it wasn't going very well. ......It was about as hopeless as going to a person who can wiggle their ears, asking them how they do it, and expecting to learn anything at all from their demonstration...

findings.sourceReading: Ange compares learning from Maria to being shown ear-wiggling by someone who can do it.
findings.alternative: Both perspectives can illustrate ineffective demonstration, but the first-person comparison specifically makes Ange the learner; MG added continuation restores learning while retaining the contradictory setup.
